document.about: True T-23-HC refrigerator spec sheet. Page 1's sidebar is an 11-item list whose `▶` bullets the font maps to the control code 0x17, each item's wrapped lines hanging under its text.

notes: #187: the control code was written into the text, and the items stayed paragraphs, one of them torn across another.

checks.issue: 11 paragraphs opened with U+0017, invalid in XML 1.0.
`… long term investment.` was a paragraph opening with U+0017.

element.text: True’s solid door reach-in’s are designed with enduring quality that protects your long term investment.

checks.issue: Bullet 4 was torn: `… (GWP). \x17 High capacity, factory balanced` and `refrigeration system …`.

element.text: High capacity, factory balanced refrigeration system that maintains cabinet temperatures of 33°F to 38°F (.5°C to 3.3°C) for the best in food preservation.
